definition.description: Retrieves a single user from Microsoft Graph API by their email address or User Principal Name (UPN). Returns the full user profile including display name, contact information, job details, and directory attributes. Useful for user lookups, validation, and fetching specific user data in workflows.

inputFields.helpText: Microsoft Graph OAuth access token with User.Read.All or Directory.Read.All permissions. Obtain via OAuth 2.0 flow or use the Connector Token node.
The email address or User Principal Name (UPN) of the user to retrieve. Can also use the user's GUID/object ID. Supports placeholders for dynamic lookups.
Comma-separated list of user properties to return (e.g., id,displayName,mail,jobTitle,department). Reduces response payload. Leave empty to return all default properties.

outputParameters.description: The complete user object containing all requested properties from Microsoft Graph
Serialized JSON string of the user object, ready for storage or transmission to external systems
Boolean indicating whether the user was found in the directory. False if user doesn't exist (404 response).
The user's unique Azure AD object ID (GUID). Empty string if user not found.
The user's display name as shown in the directory. Empty string if user not found.
The user's primary email address. May be empty if not set in directory or user not found.
The user's UPN (typically their sign-in address). Empty string if user not found.
Boolean flag indicating if an error occurred (excluding 404 not found, which is handled separately).
Detailed error message including HTTP status code and exception details if applicable.

connectionTags.description: Triggered when the user was found and their profile was successfully retrieved
Triggered when the specified user email/UPN does not exist in the directory (HTTP 404)
Triggered when an API error, authentication failure, or exception occurs during the request
